operation_proposals.source_operation: Map ranked upregulated/downregulated delta-gene sentences to quantitative log-fold changes using pre-fitted log-linear models.
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has ranking, serialization, and learned projection primitives, but none represents the documented inverse mapping from ranked gene lists to quantitative fold-change values.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Positional encoding generation and its addition to token embeddings.
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog represents the documented addition through add, but has no primitive for constructing the positional-encoding operand or specifying its encoding mechanism.
